title: Frappe ERPNext 4.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal or no roles, to access tax and charge details of arbitrary documents without proper permission checks.
